summary: Allow immutable archive optimization to select one completed test run.
details: The optional test-run selector scans only direct mod archives in one canonical completed run. Default discovery is unchanged. Stale terminal status, lease exclusion, plain paths, exact archive identity, same-volume linking, apply-time rechecks and rollback remain required.

Consumed controls cover bounded discovery, invalid and ineligible scopes, reparse and lease races, peer isolation, public command forwarding, content preservation and fixed points. Fixtures stay under primary build/tmp and create no linked checkout.

A preserved completed-run preview found its three library archives already hardlinked and no eligible duplicates. No deletion, physical space recovery or native qualification is claimed; native resource admission limits remain unchanged.

The selected router control checks the current source path, inventory, parsed module bounds and public probes. Historical migration binding proof stays pinned; the existing committed-worktree guard checks current integrity separately, matching the validation-runner control.
